material.text: abcd needs the key your model service gave you. Where it is kept decides who else on this computer can read it.

items: The keychain locks the key with your login.
A file in your home folder is readable by every program you run.

questions.ask: Where should abcd keep the key?

options.label: In the system keychain
options.meaning: The key is locked with your login; another program must ask to read it.

options.label: In a file
options.meaning: The key sits in your home folder. It works on a machine with no keychain.

later.label: Decide later
later.meaning: Nothing is stored now. abcd asks again at the next setup.

questions.change_later: run the setup again and choose the other place
